services.name: 4. Try Surfing
services.desc: The waters off the coast of Newport are home to endless adventures. Whether fishing from the shoreline, heading out with a local charter, or exploring on a kayak rental, plenty of aquatic activities can be enjoyed when staying at The Embarcadero Resort & Marina. The local waters are also ideal for catching waves, so it’s no surprise that this coastal town in Oregon hosts several popular surfing competitions. Keep reading to learn more about how you can watch talented competitors surfing in Newport, Oregon. blurb: Guests stay in individually owned and uniquely appointed rooms or suites with private balconies overlooking the harbor. Accommodations range from studio rooms to two-bedroom townhomes, some pet-friendly. The resort offers a saltwater swimming pool, crab cooking stations, and proximity to local attractions like the Oregon Coast Aquarium and Yaquina Head Lighthouse.
